desc: The Sneeky Pete SD-9 by Shark Coast Tactical is a compact, suppressior-ready 9mm PCC with a two-tone green Cerakote receiver set and Tungsten Cerakote SB Tactical SBA3 Brace and Magpul grip. Includes Vortex Crossfire red dot, Streamlight ProTac Rail Mount 2 light with pressure pad, DFCO Tiger Claw indexor for improved grip, YHM R9 suppressor and 33rd magazine.
